name: Sex Apartment
source:
You have a rare gift—the ability to communicate with your INNER SELF. Now, it's your turn to manage a cozy house full of charming ladies while your father recovers. Can you keep things running smoothly, win hearts, and uncover the house's secrets? Success or failure—it’s up to you! 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362480//]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你拥有一项罕见的天赋——与内在自我沟通的能力。现在，轮到你在父亲康复期间管理一栋充满迷人女士的舒适房子了。你能让事情顺利进行、赢得人心并揭开房子的秘密吗？成功或失败——取决于你！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362480//]Steam[/url]]
